skill_name: Discuss the environmental and health impacts of deforestation.
workflow: Deforestation has a range of environmental and health impacts. By cutting down large swaths of trees, deforestation can directly contribute to global warming and climate change by reducing the amount of carbon dioxide absorbed by plants. It can also lead to increased erosion and flooding, as trees provide the necessary physical structure to stabilize a landscape.
